item.title: Guidewire buys Hyperexponential for $1.7B in cash
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: The deal, expected to close sometime next year, is to help bring AI agents to work alongside humans to underwrite, analyze, and price decisions.

item.title: Re:Build, which spun out Slate Auto, raises $2.1B
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The manufacturing accelerator bills itself as "America’s answer to Shenzhen."

item.title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Disruptive has made headlines in recent years for pouring money into companies like chip startup Groq and the AI voice-generation startup ElevenLabs.

item.title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.

item.title: Billionaire Palmer Luckey isn’t leaving California over the wealth tax
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: "It's causing a lot of people to run who I don't want to be running," native Californian Palmer Luckey said. "But I'm planning on staying in California. I'm going to keep fighting it."

item.title: Anduril, Qualcomm launch BlueChip, a new kind of US-made laptop
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Anduril founder Palmer Luckey is vowing to bring computer manufacturing back to the U.S., and by that he doesn't just mean assembly, but every individual component, some of which are exclusively made in China today.

item.title: Nvidia backs Indian startup helping companies run AI models with fewer GPUs
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Simplismart says its annualized revenue run rate has grown fourteenfold in six months, with the U.S. accounting for more than half its revenue.

item.title: Databricks co-founder shares his secrets for winning big enterprise customers
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Turns out selling to big companies isn’t about having the shiniest tech: It’s about hitching a ride on a giant’s sales team.

item.title: Startups don’t need to go viral to win customers
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: At TechCrunch Disrupt last week, two founders and a VC discussed how to not just gain an early following but keep one.

item.title: VCs, Superhuman Mail founder share red flags about product-market fit
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Top investors from Iconiq and Sapphire Ventures, along with Rahul Vohra, the founder of Superhuman Mail, share the do's and don'ts for building hit products.

item.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 roundtables: Go deeper on the challenges founders are solving right now
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 is coming to SoWa Power Station in Boston on November 4, bringing founders, investors, and operators together for a full day of candid conversations, practical sessions, live pitching, networking, and smaller roundtables built for deeper discussion.

item.title: Carta and NewView partner, hoping to entice more startups to let employees sell shares early
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: A new program wants to encourage more startups to allow workers to cash out early by making it easier to transact tender offers.

item.title: From Toast to Bessemer: Who founders will hear from at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Hosted by TechCrunch in partnership with Fidelity Private Shares, the full-day event goes beyond fundraising and AI to explore the realities of finding customers, building teams, sharpening a pitch, developing founder leadership, and scaling companies both inside and outside traditional startup hubs.

item.title: Agent cloud startup Daytona hits $1B valuation backed by FirstMark and a who’s who of angels
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Daytona is building a cloud for agents that's like giving every agent its own computer. It has attracted founders of Stripe, Perplextity, Datadog, Mercor, and others as angels, it says.

item.title: Warhound raises $200M to engineer war dogs and arm them with Anduril gear
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Warhound, the brainchild of Ben Lamm and Palmer Luckey, emerges from stealth to genetically engineer dogs for military and law enforcement.

item.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.

item.title: The secret to fast startup growth isn’t early sales, top names in tech say
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: At this year’s Disrupt, Lovable GTM lead Luke Arno, Polsia's Ben Broca, and Theory Ventures’ Tomasz Tunguz gave founders some tips on how to achieve true sales success in the first 90 days.

item.title: Former OpenAI science lead launches Warp Science to automate wet labs with robots
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Wearing cameras and sensor gloves, the startup’s human chemists will train robots to perform various lab tasks.

item.dc:creator: Michael Schick, Isabelle Johannessen
item.description: Among the Startup Battlefield 200 were many industry-defining companies exhibiting and pitching on the Showcase Stage. Here are the standouts.

item.title: Investors break down how founders can raise a Series A today

item.description: Raising a Series A these days isn't so simple — top investors break down what founders need to know now.
